title: HustleBox v1.2.1 — Plate Fix
message:
Quick visual hotfix.

• Build plate is taller now — 'DRAG TO PLATE' text is no longer clipped on smaller screens or in the Capacitor WebView.
• Removed the 3D perspective rotation on the plate. It looked cool on desktop Chrome but caused rendering glitches on Android WebView (counter-rotated text rendering at half-height). The plate is now flat with the same shadow + gradient look — still reads as 3D, just doesn't break.
• Ingredient cards (the burger/fries/pizza tiles you drag) now have explicit padding and a min-height so the emoji + price text never get clipped on small screens.

No gameplay changes. No save data wiped.
